runs.summary: EC2 instance credentials created through an instance launch role are being used from an external IP address (203.0.113.50) outside AWS, indicating potential credential exfiltration. runs.recommended_action: Immediately revoke the compromised instance role credentials, terminate the affected EC2 instance (i-0123456789abcdef0), review S3 access logs for unauthorized data access, and investigate how credentials were exfiltrated from the instance.
